_meta.adr: ADR-037 modular register fragment — never edit shillinq_register.json
_meta.description: Adds the StandardsPolicy schema: a per-administration, ordered declaration of which accounting/reporting frameworks the administration follows and in which order of precedence. A single StandardsPolicy object holds a frameworks[] list, each entry carrying a framework key (fixed enum mirroring docs/standards/), an enabled flag and an integer precedence (lower = higher priority). Business logic consults the highest-precedence enabled framework via OCA\Shillinq\Service\StandardsPolicyService.resolve(topic) when frameworks conflict (revenue, leases, inventory, development costs — see docs/standards/comparisons.md). The resolver ships unit-tested but is not yet applied to real posting/valuation paths (out of scope per proposal). No lifecycle/orchestrator is needed: this is configuration data edited via the StandardsPolicyEditor settings page and read by the resolver.

StandardsPolicy.title: Standards policy
StandardsPolicy.description: Per-administration accounting-standards precedence policy. One object per administration declares which frameworks apply and their order of precedence. Consumed by StandardsPolicyService.resolve(topic).

administrationId.description: Optional administration scope. Null = the default policy for the register. A future enhancement may key resolution by the active administration.
administrationId.title: Administration ID

frameworks.description: Ordered list of frameworks. Each entry pins a framework key to an enabled flag and an integer precedence; the editor keeps precedence consistent with display order (lower precedence = higher priority).

key.description: Framework identifier — fixed enum mirroring the docs/standards/ pages. Covers bases of accounting (Category A): international (IFRS IASB / EU-endorsed), national GAAPs (Dutch, German, French, Italian, Spanish), tax bases (Dutch, US tax/cash/modified-cash, FRF for SMEs), public sector (IPSAS, Dutch BBV, US GASB/FASAB) and sustainability (ESRS, IFRS S1/S2). Digital-compliance obligations (e-invoicing, SAF-T, VAT) are NOT here — they are additive regulatory facts modelled by the versioned static OCA\Shillinq\Standards\ComplianceCatalogue (code, not OpenRegister).
key.title: Key

enabled.description: Whether this framework applies to the administration. Disabled frameworks are ignored by the resolver.
enabled.title: Enabled

precedence.description: Order of precedence — lower wins. The highest-priority enabled framework (lowest precedence) is returned by resolve().
precedence.title: Precedence

frameworks.title: Frameworks

notes.description: Optional free-text rationale for the chosen ordering (e.g. statutory basis), surfaced for audit.
notes.example: EU-listed group: IFRS consolidated accounts take precedence over Dutch GAAP.
notes.title: Notes

x-openregister-audit-trail.description: Every create, update and delete of a Standards policy is written to OpenRegister's immutable audit trail with actor and timestamp.
